caller_projections.entry_and_rules: Child context ordinary/loop, active/effect/update, position-dependent anchoring, coordinate-delta setters and timing; full helper reread only for new parent linkage.
Temporary tile init sets coordinates before starting animation; each update repositions then advances parent/child; disappearance uses ordinary effect; map user-sprite update/disposal.
Normal character advances parent animation first, then updates own x/y, then consumes new animation marker; no second child reanchor later in this method.
Shadow extension wraps character update then updates separate shadows; does not reanchor parent animation cells.
Map refresh invokes character update once then viewport state; no child reanchor after its x/y writes.
Command207 supplies target animation ID and clears follower override; absent target returns normally.
Grass step may issue multiple tile requests in one occupied-tile enumeration; only a conditional caller for screen-position configured record, not default record proof.
FloatSprite allocated for ordinary/new particles and tiled layer.
Particle resource assignment and reset establishes coordinates; float read-modify-write and wrap; tile origin arithmetic followed by explicit rounded projection.
Actual weather caller order prepares particles/tiles before their bounded updates; no need to export FloatSprite API.
